notes.title: Announcement on Game Progress Revamp
notes.content: [p]After the revamp was completed the week before last, the goal was to make the game more roguelike. However, it turned out that the gaming experience became worse.[/p][p]Therefore, the game process has been overhauled and reconstructed. After two weeks of exploration, we have found the right direction. The game will now shift to an idle treasure-hunting style.[/p][p]The major changes include: introducing an in-game currency system. Players can use currency to purchase one-of-three skill enhancements and buy targeted attribute upgrades.[/p][p]I will speed up the development progress. Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: 📢 Dev Log Preview | Upcoming Update
notes.content: [p]Before this Saturday, I’ll be releasing [b]Version 1.31[/b] with several important improvements:[/p][p]🔧 [b]Optimizations & Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Wave progression & balancing updates[/p][/*][*][p]Further [b]increased game difficulty[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Spore attributes nerfed[/b] for better balance[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded [b]Relic attributes[/b] for more build variety[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Next week, I’ll be [b]reworking the skill & attribute selection system after each wave[/b], bringing a clearer progression flow and more strategic choices. Here’s the new core loop:[/p][p]🎮 [b]New Flow[/b] 1️⃣ Start Game → [b]Card Pool resets[/b] (limited size, generated by weight) 2️⃣ End of a run → [b]3 random cards appear, pick 1[/b] 3️⃣ Choose a skill → [b]Skill card is added to the pool[/b] (repeat until skill limit is reached) 4️⃣ End of a wave → [b]Draw cards from your deck to gain growth[/b] 5️⃣ Continue the battle...[/p][p]✨ With this change, every build will feel more unique, and each choice will carry more weight![/p][p]Stay tuned for the upcoming test version — I’ll release it as soon as it’s ready.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.3 Pre – Update Notes
notes.content: [list][*][p]Relics of quality level 3 are now available. The background colors of previous quality 1 and 2 relics have been changed to base color and green (existing relic attributes remain unchanged; only the background color has been updated). Quality 3 relics have a blue background. Existing relic icons have been replaced.[/p][/*][*][p]In this demo, the maximum relic quality is 3 (blue). More relic types of qualities 1, 2, and 3, as well as special attributes, will be added in future updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Endless mode difficulty has been further increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Version 1.3 will be released later on Friday. During the weekend, additional character attributes will be added to make the relic system more diverse.[/p][/*][*][p]Various basic optimizations.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.3pre Version Update
notes.content: [p]1. Added the initial version of the Relic System. Relics will randomly drop during waves, with Quality Level 2 relics dropping randomly after wave 200.[/p][p]   Currently, there are only two qualities with limited attributes available. In the next couple of days, I will expand the system by adding more qualities and attributes. Over the coming week, I will continue updating and improving the Relic System.[/p][p]2. Fixed an issue in the previous version where the maximum item limit did not work, allowing players to reach extremely high waves.[/p][p]3. Changed boss drops to provide one attribute selection per drop.[/p][p]4. Enabled the 1.3pre version leaderboard.[/p][p]5. Various optimizations.[/p][p]**Note:** If your save file encounters issues after updating to the new version, please check the `bug-list` channel in the game’s Discord for instructions on how to roll back your save.[/p][p]If the game still cannot start or displays incorrectly, please leave a message in the Discord or on Steam. Thank you very much![/p]
